usage: The word 蒸 can be used as a verb meaning 'to steam' food.
蒸 describes a cooking method where food is cooked by steam heat.
It can also be used as an adjective to describe food that has been steamed.
In Cantonese, 蒸 is often used in menu descriptions to indicate healthy cooking style with less oil.
When 蒸 is combined with food items, it tells you that the dish is prepared by steaming, for example '蒸雞' (steamed chicken).
